import os, sys, json, time, math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

OUT=Path('/app/output')

def points_from_depth(rgb, depth, camera):
    rgb=np.asarray(rgb)
    d=np.asarray(depth,dtype=np.float64)
    if d.ndim==3: d=d[0]
    K=np.asarray(camera['intrinsic_cv'],dtype=np.float64)
    M=np.asarray(camera['cam2world_gl'],dtype=np.float64)
    h,w=d.shape
    yy,xx=np.indices((h,w))
    X=(xx-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*d
    Y=-(yy-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*d
    cam=np.stack((X,Y,-d),axis=-1)
    world=cam@M[:3,:3].T+M[:3,3]
    return world

def hand_point(rgb,depth,camera,center=None):
    """Robust 3D centroid of visible white palm/finger pixels in front view."""
    im=np.asarray(rgb).astype(np.int16)
    d=np.asarray(depth,dtype=np.float64)
    if d.ndim==3:d=d[0]
    wpts=points_from_depth(im,d,camera)
    h,w=d.shape
    yy,xx=np.indices((h,w))
    mask=(im.min(axis=2)>185)&(d>.4)&(d<2.0)&(wpts[:,:,2]>.59)&(wpts[:,:,2]<1.0)
    mask &= (xx>70)&(xx<245)&(yy>45)&(yy<150)
    # remove the table and green target using height and chroma
    mask &= (np.ptp(im,axis=2)<55)
    pts=wpts[mask]
    if len(pts)<10:
        raise RuntimeError(f'hand segmentation sparse: {len(pts)}')
    # discard high forearm outliers and return the center of the lower hand cluster
    if center is not None:
        dis=np.linalg.norm(pts-center,axis=1)
        near=pts[dis<.18]
        if len(near)>=10: pts=near
    # trimmed coordinate median is stable to bright wrist/background pixels
    med=np.median(pts,axis=0)
    near=pts[np.linalg.norm(pts-med,axis=1)<.09]
    if len(near)>=10: med=np.median(near,axis=0)
    return med, len(pts)

def robot_setup():
    r=Robot()
    s=r.spec()
    return r,s

def getobs(r,s):
    cams=['front','side','top','oblique']
    return r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames')

def get_state(r,s):
    o=getobs(r,s)
    p=o.meta['proprio']['now']
    q=np.asarray(p[58:87],float)
    hp,n=hand_point(o.last['front'],o.depth['front'],o.meta['cameras']['front'])
    return o,q,hp,n

def command(r,s,q,dt=.5,note=''):
    a=np.asarray(q,float).reshape(1,-1)
    return r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=dt,interpolate='linear',cameras=['front','side','top','oblique'],video_fps=10,video='mp4',include_depth=True,note=note)

def save_result(res,name):
    p=OUT/'debug'/name
    res.save(str(p))
    return p

if __name__=='__main__':
    r,s=robot_setup()
    o,q,hp,n=get_state(r,s)
    print('q',q[:7].round(4),'hand',hp.round(4),'pixels',n,'task',o.meta['task'],'time',o.meta['time_left_s'])
    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='probe':
        for j in range(7):
            q1=q.copy(); q1[j]+=0.08
            rr=command(r,s,q1,dt=.5,note=f'jac probe joint {j+1} plus')
            oo=r.get_obs(cameras=['front'],include_depth=True,video='frames')
            h1,_=hand_point(oo.last['front'],oo.depth['front'],oo.meta['cameras']['front'],center=hp)
            print('probe',j,'plus',h1.round(4),'delta',((h1-hp)/.08).round(4),'meta',rr.meta.get('task',{}).get('goal_index'))
            command(r,s,q,dt=.5,note=f'restore probe joint {j+1}')
        print('restored')
